title: iRacing Coach report storage reclaim v1
description: Result of the reclaim_report_storage tool (GAP-025, PORT-007). mode 'plan' is read-only: which older copies of saved analyses a confirmation would move (remove) and how many report directories stay (kept). mode 'execute' is the confirmed move of one reviewed plan: each listed directory was re-checked under the history-index write lock immediately before it moved, and moved whole by one rename into recovery_root/<batch>, or was skipped with a reason. The backend decides every eligibility; a consumer only displays these values. Directories are relative to reports_root. Sizes are bytes and counts are non-negative integers; numeric domains are stated here because the repository's bounded validator supports no numeric keywords. Objects may gain optional fields; consumers must preserve unknown fields and fail on a missing required field or another contract/schema_version.

status.description: plan: ready (something can be removed), nothing, empty (no reports) or index-unreadable (nothing is offered while the history index cannot be read). execute: complete (every listed directory moved), partial (some moved, some skipped) or nothing (none moved).

read_only.description: true exactly when mode is plan.

recovery_root.description: The removed-reports folder beside reports. Moved copies stay there, recoverable, until the driver deletes it.

plan_id.description: 32 lowercase hex characters naming the plan's directory list. In execute mode, the plan rebuilt when the confirmation arrived.

confirmed_plan_id.description: execute only: the plan_id the driver confirmed.

duplicate_count.description: Repeats of an analysis another kept copy holds.

superseded_count.description: Copies from an older analyzer revision of a session whose newer analysis is kept.

oldest_utc.description: Oldest listed copy's analysis.json write time; null when nothing is listed.

kept.description: plan only. by_reason sums to count.

deferred.description: Eligible copies beyond the 5,000 one confirmation may list; the next review offers them.

batch_directory.description: execute only: the recovery_root subfolder this confirmation moved copies into; null when none moved.

reason.description: referenced: the index, a saved test, a tuning record or the app now names it. in-use: a file inside is open. changed: it or the copy it repeats changed since review. missing: already gone. not-eligible: never offered. index-unavailable: the history index could not be locked. move-failed: the rename failed for another reason.

bytes.description: Bytes waiting in recovery_root for the driver to delete.

kept_copy.description: The directory that stays: the identical copy, or the newer analysis of the same session and recording.
